guard: A host release inside a scope cancels no sibling: cancelling would settle in-flight sibling entries `cancelled`, and a later resume replays that cancellation into a healthy run, permanently. (FAIL-FAST suite: markers are upstream of the cells they guard.)

mutations.name: a release inside parallel is treated as a branch failure and cancels siblings
mutations.replace: // mutant: a release rides the branch-failure path and cancels siblings
mutations.expectRed: so a healthy driver resumes past a parallel it was stopped inside
mutations.completionMarker: ok a host stop inside parallel releases the run rather than failing it
mutations.cell: so a healthy driver resumes past a parallel it was stopped inside
mutations.note: The scope still stays pending under the mutant (the performScope ladder rethrows the release), so the release cell and the pending cell stay green; what the mutant durably breaks is the sibling's in-flight entry, settled `cancelled`, which only the RESUME cell can see.

mutations.name: a release inside fanOut is treated as a branch failure and cancels siblings
mutations.replace: // mutant: a release rides the branch-failure path and cancels siblings
mutations.expectRed: so a healthy driver resumes past a fanOut it was stopped inside
mutations.completionMarker: ok so a healthy driver resumes past a parallel it was stopped inside
mutations.cell: so a healthy driver resumes past a fanOut it was stopped inside
mutations.note: Same shape as the parallel mutant, on the fanOut copy of the guard; the parallel iteration runs first and stays green, so the marker proves the run reached the fanOut half before dying.

mutations.name: a released race arm counts as a candidate and wins by failing
mutations.find:
(e: unknown) =>
          onSettle(
            i,
            e instanceof Cancelled || e instanceof RunReleased || e instanceof RunHeld || e instanceof JournalAppendRejected,
          ),
mutations.expectRed: a race whose sibling was released still lets in-flight work win, and the run completes
mutations.completionMarker: ok so a healthy driver resumes past a fanOut it was stopped inside
mutations.cell: a race whose sibling was released still lets in-flight work win, and the run completes
mutations.note: Under the mutant the released arm settles the race as a candidate, cancels the arm whose sleep was already in flight, and the winner scan finds no candidate, so the run releases instead of completing and the sibling's entry is durably cancelled.
